messages.content: Assess the current array and tell me which detected issues need attention and which limitations remain.

Assessment complete. The 2×3 inset-fed patch array at 2.45 GHz on FR4 has one actionable warning and several informational findings. The warning: the overhang-union cylinders added to the two rightmost-column elements (row 1 col 3 and row 2 col 3) extend 12.38 mm beyond the substrate edge, creating 309 mm² of unsupported copper. This is a manufacturability/reliability concern—those overhangs have no dielectric support. All six ports show 'attachment unknown' for their positive terminals (geometric coincidence cannot be resolved within the polygonal approximation), but their negative terminals attach cleanly to the ground plane. Several union operations between patch pieces and the overhang tools fall within the curved-boundary approximation uncertainty (info only). Fundamental limitations: these checks are geometry-only—no impedance, resonance, coupling, efficiency, or full-wave RF performance is evaluated. Curved boundaries (cylinders) are approximated polygonal, so near-boundary relationships carry an error bound (~0.13 mm).
